thesisSources.name: KTH Degree Project Portal
thesisSources.desc: Degree projects offered to KTH students by companies and organisations. Filter by subject, from computer science and energy to medical engineering, and by 15 or 30 credits.

thesisSources.name: KI degree project database
thesisSources.desc: Projects offered by KI researchers and Karolinska University Hospital clinics, from public health to surgery. Over 170 projects were listed in October 2026.

thesisSources.name: Company theses at DSV
thesisSources.desc: Master's thesis proposals from companies for students at the Department of Computer and Systems Sciences, shared with every student through NEXTiLearn.

thesisSources.name: Degree projects in physics
thesisSources.desc: Find a project by contacting a research group at the Department of Physics. An information meeting with example projects is held each November or December.

thesisSources.name: Degree projects in mathematical statistics
thesisSources.desc: Suggested master's topics from supervisors at the Department of Mathematics and partners. Many entries are older, so ask the supervisor if the topic is still available.

thesisSources.name: RISE thesis projects
thesisSources.desc: Thesis projects at the Research Institutes of Sweden, including Kista. Most projects are posted during the autumn semester.

thesisSources.name: Scania thesis projects
thesisSources.desc: Thesis projects in Södertälje for bachelor's and master's students. Application periods: 1 October to 22 November 2026, and 1 March to 1 June 2027.
